description: Use this endpoint to delete credit card details for an account or service. Note, for use with billable Services (billParentAccount=false) only.

description: Use this endpoint to store credit card details or update credit card details for an account or service. Note, for use with billable Services (billParentAccount=false) only.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Provide the account id to update the credit card info.

fields.name: cardType
fields.description: Specidy the type of credit card, for example VISA.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Provide the credit card number.

fields.name: holder
fields.description: Provide the credit card holder's name.

description: Use this endpoint to get a list of deposits applied to an account where {id} is the accountId or the serviceId.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account id to get deposits.

params.name: status
params.description: Status strings are used to represent multiple statuses within a single string, making it easier to manage and process different status values. To illustrate this better, let's consider an example with the status value "OPEN".  if want to add more values instead of using separate strings we can use a comma-delimited status string to combine them into one, like this:  "OPEN,RETURNED".

params.name: paymentId
params.description: The related payment ID if applicable.

params.name: refundId
params.description: The related refund ID if applicable.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: The starting date to get the deposits for in format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: toDate
params.description: The ending date to get the deposits for in format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: type
params.description: A code indicating the type of deposit.

params.name: productCode
params.description: The product code that related to the deposit.

description: Use this endpoint to apply a deposit to an account where {id} is the accountId or the serviceId.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Provide the account id to add a deposit.

fields.name: type
fields.description: A code indicating the type of deposit.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Provide the currency of the deposit to be applied to the account. For a list of ISO4217 currency codes please reference http://www.xe.com/iso4217.php

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Provide the amount of the deposit.

fields.name: note
fields.description: A note regarding the deposit.

description: Use this endpoint to get a list of invoices related to an Account or Service. Note, for use with billable Services (billParentAccount=false) only.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Provide the account id to retrieve invoices.

params.name: status
params.description: Specify if an invoice is open (unpaid) or closed (paid), use 0 or 2 respectively. If no value is provided, the request will retrieve both open and closed invoices. The only allowed values for this parameter are 0 or 2.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Enter the starting date in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: toDate
params.description: Enter the ending date in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.

description: Use this endpoint to apply a transaction to an Account or Service. Note, for use with billable Services (billParentAccount=false) only.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Provide the account id to process a payment.

fields.name: saveCard
fields.description: If true credit card information that's provided in the credit card object will be stored for future convinance.

fields.name: useExistingCard
fields.description: If true, credit card information does not have to be provided to process a transaction, the stored credit card will be used.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: A reference value that you may want to associate with the transaction.

fields.name: isServicePayment
fields.description: If true, the account/service validity period will be extended. If left empty or false, only a payment will be applied to the account/service but the validity period will not change.

fields.name: remark
fields.description: A general text remark regarding this payment.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Provide the amount of the payment to be applied to the account.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Provide the currency of the payment to be applied to the account. For a list of ISO4217 currency codes please reference http://www.xe.com/iso4217.php.

fields.name: desiredDueDate
fields.description: date/time

fields.description: date time
